limits: Every displayed current-release timing is separate from the interleaved 0.5.2 drift controls.
GNU time wraps timed commands; independent checksum and stated metadata checks run outside timing. Largest-process RSS is not aggregate memory.
Shared hosts, metadata caches and NFS server caches are uncontrolled. Endpoint placeholders replace private operational identities.
Short or incomplete series remain in the data; chart eligibility is computed from recorded repetitions, verification and duration.
Portable recipes and matching public harness modules are available; original operational drivers and host details remain private.

featured.title: WAN: one 8 GiB file
featured.workload: One 8 GiB regular file. Flat directory, warm tmpfs source → remote XFS RAID; approximately 262.3 ms RTT. Sender NIC: 1 Gb/s (125 MB/s nominal ceiling).
featured.caveat: Three verified repetitions per current-release setting. A fresh 0.5.2 control followed the first syq run. Shared host and server-cache conditions are recorded in the data.

preparation.original: Sequential Python Random(9911).randbytes in 1 MiB blocks; fully written pseudorandom data, no sparse files; flat f0000… names; file mtimes fixed to 1700000000. Memory-resident tmpfs source.

featured.title: LAN: 600,000 small files
featured.workload: 600,000 × 4 KiB files in 256 directories (2.29 GiB total). RAID → RAID, approximately 0.2 ms RTT; both servers use 2 × 10 Gb/s bonds.
featured.caveat: Three verified repetitions per current-release setting. A fresh 0.5.2 control followed the first syq run. Shared host and server-cache conditions are recorded in the data. Both hosts use two-port 10 Gb/s bonds; this refresh did not repeat the earlier per-port traffic diagnostic.

featured.title: Fast fabric: one large file
featured.workload: One 8 GiB file, tmpfs → tmpfs between servers in the same data center.
featured.caveat: Three verified repetitions per current-release setting. A fresh 0.5.2 control followed the first syq run. Shared host and server-cache conditions are recorded in the data. Timing includes an empty fixture probe; syq used eight rails while rclone used one.

preparation.original: Current harness: generated pseudorandom file contents with seed 9911; large files in the source tree. The harness generated data with O_DIRECT where supported and requested fixture-page eviction with fadvise; metadata caches stayed warm. Tmpfs remained memory-resident; this fixture also included an empty O_DIRECT probe file.

featured.title: Hetzner WAN: one 4 GiB file
featured.workload: One 4 GiB file, warm tmpfs source to a cloud VM root filesystem. Germany to US East Coast; approximately 108 ms RTT. Two CCX23 guests with four dedicated vCPUs and 16 GiB RAM each.
featured.caveat: Three verified copies per setting. SFTP ran in a later block after a host-key correction; additional paired release controls matched. No final durability flush.
